core_competencies.label: Find removable complexity before adding code.
Account for token, maintenance, dependency, and coordination cost.
Set a concrete stopping rule tied to proof.
Preserve mandatory safety and correctness controls.

failure_traps.description: Adds abstractions for hypothetical future scope without present evidence.
Removes required controls or failure evidence to make the change smaller.

claim_policy: scope decision is validated only when acceptance criteria, current surface, and stopping rule are explicit.
